PM Modi Inaugurates Paris Temple, Highlights India-France Ties

Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the inauguration ceremony of the Swaminarayan temple in Paris, stating that India-France relations have reached new heights. He noted that both nations are increasing cooperation in areas such as technology, AI, defense, space, and climate. The Prime Minister participated in the event virtually.
